notes: Each programme's own Entry requirements page was used (degree and specific requirements); English 6 is stated only as an example (IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale), so IELTS is flagged recommended and TOEFL is text only. Joint programmes with separate application processes (Cybersecurity and Assurance, Decentralized Smart Energy Systems, ICT Innovation (EIT), Environomical Pathways, Advanced Energy Systems and AI, Mathematics, Nuclear Energy, Renewable Energy, Smart Electrical Networks and Systems, InnoEnergy) were skipped. No grade thresholds, Chinese-degree pages or PDFs were used; selection is competitive and the official pages state no minimum grade. The January deadline year comes from the heading 'studies starting August 2027'. Coordinator: deadlines removed: '15 January: Last day to apply' states no year; the 2027 in the quote is the year studies start, so the deadline year was inferred (Lund's identical wording was left out too).
